title: Amazon's $66,000 Camera Lens
description: A 60-second lesson on Amazon's $66,000 Camera Lens.

hook.text: A $250 camera lens appeared on Amazon for $66,000. Two pricing bots kept outbidding each other in an infinite loop.

buildup.text: Third-party sellers use algorithms to automatically match or beat competitors' prices on Amazon.

discovery.text: Two bots targeted the same product. One priced 27% higher than the other, which priced 1% higher than the first.

twist.text: With no price ceiling, the bots spiraled. The lens price hit $23 million before anyone noticed and intervened.

climax.text: This incident proved that automated systems without guardrails can produce absurd outcomes at machine speed.

punchline.text: Two bots. No limits. A $250 lens priced at millions.

quiz.question: What caused the runaway pricing on Amazon?
options: Two pricing bots outbidding each other without limits
